meta.title: AgentBridge — GitHub MCP Tool Execution & Policy Decision Workflow
meta.subtitle: Read-Only Classification, PolicyEngine Risk Boundary, MCP Dispatch & Activity Auditing
meta.description: Decision workflow governing tool execution through the GitHub MCP Connector. Details read-only auto-approval vs mutating/unknown tool authorization, PolicyEngine evaluation, MCP client execution over Streamable HTTP, error normalization, and ActivityStore auditing.

states.label: Verify Connected State
states.description: Checks if connector is connected and MCP session is in READY state.

states.label: Is Connected?
states.description: Branch on connection state. If not connected, reject with ConnectorNotConnectedError.

states.label: Record Audit Start
states.description: Records tool call start in ActivityStore with sanitized arguments and request_id.

states.label: Is Read-Only Tool?
states.description: Evaluates tool prefix (get_, list_, read_, search_, view_, describe_) or tool metadata read_only flag.

states.label: PolicyEngine Risk Evaluation
states.description: Evaluates deterministic precedence: CRITICAL invariants > Session Grants > Persistent Policy > Default Risk.

states.label: Authorized by Policy?
states.description: Checks if PolicyEngine allowed execution (or auto-allowed LOW risk tool_read).

states.label: Raise ConnectorPermissionError
states.description: Mutating or high-risk operation rejected without approval. Audited and returned with error.

states.label: MCPClient.call_tool()
states.description: Dispatches JSON-RPC tools/call over Streamable HTTP transport with request timeout.

states.label: Sanitize Result & Scrub Secrets
states.description: Redacts secrets from result content and structured data blocks.

states.label: Record Audit Completion
states.description: Records completion status, duration_ms, and result in ActivityStore.

states.label: Return ConnectorResult
states.description: Normalized ConnectorResult returned to caller with success flag, content, and metadata.
